tasks.title: Seed Treatment with Pseudomonas
tasks.notes: Treat seeds with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/kg before sowing.

tasks.title: Nursery Light Irrigation
tasks.notes: Keep seedbed moist with gentle watering.

tasks.title: Transplanting Seedlings
tasks.notes: Transplant 2-3 seedlings per hill at 20x10 cm spacing.

tasks.title: First Top Dressing of Nitrogen
tasks.notes: Apply Urea @ 25 kg/acre during active tillering stage.

tasks.title: Hand Weeding / Cono Weeding
tasks.notes: Perform mechanical or hand weeding to keep field clean.

tasks.title: Second Top Dressing (N & K)
tasks.notes: Apply Urea and MOP at panicle initiation stage.

tasks.title: Blast / Stem Borer Protective Spray
tasks.notes: Foliar spray only if disease incidence noticed. Avoid spray in high winds.

tasks.title: Drain Field Water
tasks.notes: Drain all standing water 10-14 days before harvest.

tasks.title: Harvest Crop
tasks.notes: Harvest when 80-85% grains turn straw yellow.

source: REPLACE WITH VERIFIED DATA - TNAU Agritech Portal (Crop Production Guide: Paddy)

tasks.title: Transplant Seedlings
tasks.notes: Transplant 25-30 day old seedlings to main field.

tasks.title: Drip / Furrow Irrigation
tasks.notes: Irrigate according to soil moisture and weather conditions.

tasks.title: Staking & Trellising
tasks.notes: Stake indeterminate plants with bamboo or wire supports.

tasks.title: Micronutrient Foliar Spray
tasks.notes: Spray Boron and Calcium complex to prevent blossom end rot.

tasks.title: First Fruit Harvest
tasks.notes: Harvest breaker or turning stage fruits for market.

source: REPLACE WITH VERIFIED DATA - Kerala Agricultural University (Package of Practices: Vegetables)

tasks.title: Sucker / TC Plant Sowing
tasks.notes: Plant in 50x50x50 cm pits filled with FYM and topsoil.

tasks.title: Regular Basin / Drip Irrigation
tasks.notes: Provide 15-20 litres water/plant/day depending on temperature.

tasks.title: First Dose Fertilization (NPK)
tasks.notes: Apply Urea 50g, SSP 150g, MOP 50g per plant.

tasks.title: Second Dose Fertilization
tasks.notes: Apply Urea 75g and MOP 100g around the drip circle.

tasks.title: Bunch Sleeving and Propping
tasks.notes: Tie bamboo poles for support and cover bunch with perforated polybags.

tasks.title: Harvest Banana Bunches
tasks.notes: Harvest bunches when fingers are 3/4th rounded with angular ridges fading.

source: REPLACE WITH VERIFIED DATA - ICAR - National Research Centre for Banana (NRCB)
